description: "Cinq-Mars" by Alfred de Vigny is a historical novel written in the early 19th century. The narrative is set against the backdrop of 17th century France, exploring themes of loyalty, ambition, and the intricate dynamics of court life, particularly focusing on the character of Henri d'Effiat, Marquis de Cinq-Mars.
